thread.text:
Sold 1/3rd around 3r on day one of move trailing rest risk free #fcl
Everything risk free now with 2/3rd size holding all 👇

I trailing with structure so unless I get higher low point I keep same sl instead of sl at cost ,my backtesting shows sl at cost gets hit on minor pullbacks
Example molbio yesterday

expected_vision.structure_note: 75-minute candles; price ranges roughly 41.00-45.75 across the visible window, chops in a 42.00-44.50 band for most of the chart, then a green candle pushes from about 44.00 to 45.75 on the rightmost bars. A dotted teal horizontal line sits at the current price (45.75) -- the charting platform's own live-price marker, not something the poster drew. A red downward-pointing arrow sits above the breakout candle with no price number attached to it.
Not a price chart -- a multi-symbol positions/watchlist list (FCL, AEROFLEX, AEQUS, DATAPATTNS, NETWEB, JGCHEM) showing today's LTP and percent change for each. No chart structure to read.

unresolved: entry price never stated in text or any attached image
stop stated only as 'risk free' (moved to cost); no absolute price, and entry price is unknown so it can't be derived either
R-multiple '3r' given, not a percentage or a price -- cannot compute net_result_pct
reply about trailing methodology ('sl at cost gets hit on minor pullbacks') gives no new price for FCL
reply '30/75 usually .' answers an un-archived parent post and cannot be interpreted

notes: Root post is itself a partial-exit statement -- no entry post is in this archive at all (the position was presumably opened before the capture window). Classified trade_event by llm/classify.py (fixture 2089923284565700807_fcl_partial_exit.json) on 2026-08-23; the human event label there is 'partial_exit', which the reconciled status='partial' matches.
'Sold 1/3rd' is recorded as exits[0].qty_pct=33.3 (1/3 rounded to one decimal), matching the fraction actually written rather than inventing false precision (33.333...) or rounding to a bare 33.

JUDGMENT CALL: 'Everything risk free now' clearly means the stop moved to breakeven (cost), matching reconcile.md's own worked phrase. But we cannot output a numeric stop.price because the entry price it would be based on was never captured -- 'risk free' names a relationship to an unknown number, not a number itself.

The two later self-replies (2091094235131109810, 2091100962375258264) are general stop-loss philosophy and an unresolvable terse reply to a missing parent post. Neither should move any FCL field -- this fixture specifically tests that the reconciler doesn't manufacture new state from tangential thread noise.

Both attached images are transcribed as evidence but contribute nothing extractable: the 75m chart has no printed price on its only annotation (an arrow), and the multi-symbol watchlist screenshot is marked unreadable (not a price chart) under the same vision.md rule 5 reading used in the RATEGAIN fixture.
